hash_definition: SHA-256 of json.dumps(training settings, sort_keys=True) + the session-to-fold CSV, as computed and stored by scripts/nash5_panel_bar.py in results/tables/nash5_panel_bar.json
pipeline_version: de-duplicated demographics merge (phase0_preprocessing.merge_demographics keeps the demographics row dated closest to each rating visit); five training seeds

data.task_items: FT, OC, PS, PT x left/right (8 items)
data.half_point_labels: 7 of 5,734 labels are means of two attempts (utils/parsing.parse_score); one cell has range 1.5
data.disagreement_bands: unanimous r = 0; adjacent 0 < r < 2; highly disputed r >= 2; extreme r >= 3

model.architecture: two Linear-ReLU hidden layers of 32 units, then nn.Linear(32, 4): four threshold outputs with independent weights, trained with the CORAL target encoding and loss (not weight-shared, rank-consistent CORAL); prediction = number of outputs with p > 0.5 (models/ordinal_model.py)
model.features: leave-one-task-out consensus of the other seven task items, standardised on the training fold
model.seed_mechanism: scripts/dedup_multiseed.py and scripts/dedup_triples_multiseed.py pass seed= to every utils/nash_training fit; DEFAULT_SEED = 42 applies only when no seed is passed

nash.solver: utils/nash_solver.solve_nash_weights: truncated projected-gradient ascent on sum(alpha * log gamma) over the simplex, Frank-Wolfe step sizes 2/(k+2), <= 250 iterations, stop when the L1 change < 1e-6; gamma = s - min(s) + 1, s = loss / max(EMA(loss), 1e-6), loss EMA 0.9
nash.kwargs_source: utils/settings.py NASH_KWARGS, imported by scripts/comparators.py and scripts/panel_size.py
nash.min_weight_application: np.maximum(solved, 0.1) then divide by the sum
nash.gradient_combination: each rater's gradient normalised to unit L2 length, then combined with the smoothed weights

comparators.consensus_mean: single target = mean of available rater labels
comparators.reliability_weighted: single target = reliability-weighted mean of available labels; weights = leave-one-rater-out quadratic kappa on the training fold, floored at 0.01 (scripts/comparators.py)

cv.splitter: sklearn GroupKFold, groups = subject_id, applied at session level (scripts/panel_size.fixed_fold_map)
cv.same_folds_for: all five-rater arms, the R1-R3 panel-size arms and the ten three-rater panels

evaluation.metric: mean over raters of quadratic-weighted kappa against each rater's own labels on the rows that rater scored; fold mean, then averaged over seeds

bootstrap.estimand: paired; same subject draws for every arm; kappa averaged over seeds within each resample; percentile 2.5 / 97.5

evaluation.entropy_rho: Spearman(predictive entropy, inter-rater range) on out-of-fold rows, per seed, averaged over seeds; difference CI from the same 400 resamples

inset_jitter_display_only.note: horizontal jitter only; trend lines use unjittered values
